name: Weekly momentum on BTC followers (ETH unseen years, SOL)

history.reason: Pre-registered test (ETHUSDT 1d 2017-08..2019-12, run 20261113-083106-e305a6; SOLUSDT 1d 2020-08..2025-10, run 20261113-083106-c0e1a0). Did not reproduce. ETH failed rules 1, 2, 4 and 5: Sharpe 0.13 vs 0.15, -32% against -10% for ETH at the same 48% exposure, break-even 0 bps, better Sharpe from 53% of 1-year starts; passed rule 3 (drawdown -78% vs -94%). SOL failed rules 1 and 5: Sharpe 1.08 vs 1.24, better Sharpe from 43% of 1-year starts; passed 2-4 (+1,884% vs +1,756% at the same exposure, drawdown -67% vs -96%, break-even 170 bps vs 26). The smaller drawdown replicated; the edge over holding did not. The ETH 2020-25 result is best read as luck in that period. The BTC-leads variant (trade ETH or SOL on BTC's weekly return) remains untested and would be a new note and new trials.
